title: Permutation-Based Pre-trained Model Merging via Reciprocal Orthogonality
abstract: arXiv:2611.13016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ito et al. (2026) showed that sufficiently wide, independently trained neural networks can exhibit linear mode connectivity (LMC) with softmax temperature calibration, even without permutation. LMC means that a low-loss linear path connects the models' parameters. This behavior is explained by layerwise exponentially weighted connectivity (LEWC), whereby each merged layer outputs an exponentially weighted sum of the original models' corresponding representations, yielding ensemble-like predictions. However, prior work observed LEWC with substantial widening, such as 8192 units per hidden layer for MLPs and $16\times$ width for VGG-11, raising the question of whether such widths are necessary. We therefore search for permutations that encourage reciprocal orthogonality (RO), which suppresses interference between each model's weights and the other model's representations. This allows both models' computations to coexist in the merged netwo

translated_title: 基于相互正交性的置换式预训练模型合并
translated_abstract: Ito等人（2026）表明，足够宽的独立训练神经网络即使不进行置换，也可以通过softmax温度校准表现出线性模式连通性（LMC）。LMC意味着存在一条低损失的线性路径连接模型的参数。这种行为可以由逐层指数加权连通性（LEWC）来解释，即每个合并层输出原始模型对应表示的指数加权和，从而产生类似集成的预测。然而，先前的工作是在大幅加宽网络的条件下观察到LEWC的，例如MLP每个隐藏层需要8192个单元，VGG-11需要16倍宽度，这引发了这样的问题：如此大的宽度是否必要。因此，我们搜索能够促进相互正交性（RO）的置换，该性质可以抑制每个模型的权重与另一个模型表示之间的干扰。这使得两个模型的计算能够在合并后的网络中共存。
tldr: 提出通过搜索促进相互正交性（RO）的置换来合并预训练模型，无需大幅加宽网络即可抑制模型间的干扰，使两个模型的计算能够在合并网络中共存。
